purpose: Z rune in porcelain, carapace and titanium enamel on neutral graphite

variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: premium sculpted desktop application icon for hgs zerus.
Input image 1: the approved Z rune; use it ONLY as the letter shape and composition reference. Preserve its recognizable uppercase Z silhouette, two broad hooked horizontal bars and the strong single diagonal connecting stroke. No circular swirl or threefold symbol.
Input image 2: material and finish reference ONLY. Translate its material language onto the Z, do not copy its Swarm shape.
Primary request: transform the Z into a refined, richly constructed sculptural emblem. The letter itself is the entire subject. Keep the large clear counterspaces, tapered sharp tips, balanced silhouette and readable Z. Introduce convincing crisp bevels, layered cross-sections and carefully fitted material insets. Detail must support a bold app icon, not become ornamental clutter.
Composition: square 1024 x 1024 image, centered front-facing near-orthographic emblem, with subtle visible edge depth, approximately 82% canvas width and height and generous unclipped margins.
Backdrop: completely neutral very dark graphite #171717 across the entire square. NO teal or green tint in background or lighting. Opaque square asset, no rounded-square outline, no enclosing badge, no floor horizon, no extra shadow tile.
Lighting: restrained neutral studio key light from upper left, gentle highlight on bevels, dark occlusion between materials; elegant controlled contrast, no bloom.
Constraints: no text beyond the Z-shaped object, no wordmark, no watermark, no UI, no extra symbols. No purple. No soft inflated plastic, no neon glow, no cyan ambient haze. Keep the image-reference-1 silhouette immediately recognizable.
Material direction: PORCELAIN. Broad warm ivory glazed ceramic faces form the main Z; sharply folded ceramic planes and a thick dark graphite underside create dimensional structure. Recessed deep turquoise enamel channels follow the top and bottom strokes and a single clean portion of the diagonal. Brushed warm copper accents line selected inner bevels; copper is a restrained high-contrast secondary material, not a border around everything. Material proportions roughly 65% ivory ceramic, 23% turquoise enamel and 12% warm copper. Quiet tactile ceramic with refined specular response, flawless intentional edges. A stylish luminous ivory Z with inset color, not a uniformly colored toy.
